About Madi

Images built to open doors

I'm Madi — a Sydney-based Photographer working with models, actors, dancers, and creatives who are ready to build imagery that opens doors.

I've been behind the lens for over 10 years, and what drives me is simple: I want your photos to feel like you — not a version of you that had to perform for the camera. Real expression, real range, real results.

With a background in screen & media and experience across studio and on-location video and photo shoots, I bring both technical precision and a relaxed, guided approach that helps you feel at ease from the very first frame.

90% of my clients get into their desired agency using the headshots and portfolio work we create together. That's not luck — it's the right images, built with intention.

— Madi Crasti

FAQ

Questions about the quiz

How long does the quiz take?

Under a minute! It's just 5 quick questions designed to understand your craft, your experience, and your goals — so I can match you with the right session.

How many questions are there?

Five short questions in total. A couple of them let you pick more than one answer, and there's always an optional space to add more detail if you'd like.

Do I need to sign up to start?

No — you can jump straight in with zero commitment. I only ask for your details at the very end, once your result is ready, so I can send it to you and help with next steps.

What happens after I finish?

You'll be matched with one of my signature sessions, complete with a personalised recommendation, what's included, and pricing — plus an easy way to book or get in touch if it feels like the right fit.

Is it really free?

100% free with no obligation. The quiz is simply the easiest way to figure out which shoot suits you before you decide anything.

    FAQ

    Questions about my sessions

    How long does a session take?

    Sessions typically run between 1–2 hours depending on the package. I always allow a little extra time so we're never rushing, and you get the range of shots you need.

    Where do you shoot?

    I shoot at any Sydney outdoor location that suits your vibe and goals — streets, parks, urban and architectural spots. Studio hire is also available for an additional cost if you'd prefer a controlled backdrop.

    How quickly will I get my photos back?

    Your edited gallery is delivered within 2–5 business days. Every image is carefully retouched — I won't rush the edit — but I know how important it is to have your photos quickly, especially for agency submissions.

    How many images do I get?

    Each package includes a set number of fully retouched images of your choice, plus access to your full online gallery to view everything from the shoot. The exact number depends on the session you book.

    What should I wear?

    I'll send you a personalised style guide after you book. As a starting point: bring 2–3 outfit options that feel authentically you, including at least one neutral and one that shows your personality. Avoid busy patterns and logos.

    I've never had professional photos taken — will that be a problem?

    Not at all — that's exactly what my sessions are designed for. I direct you through every pose and moment. Most first-timers feel nervous for about 5 minutes and relaxed completely after that.
